📋 Updates: Template editor button redesign: Completely redesigned the button details modal.
Templates now support custom size/colors: You can now customize the size and colors of individual button frames.
Beta Testing Bind Updater: Added a new feature for updating the base binds file directly from GitHub.
Element Duplication Shortcut: Added a new feature to duplicate elements using the Ctrl + D shortcut.
Added a better FAQ modal: Introduced an interactive FAQ in the help section to assist users with common issues.
New theme: Added a new dark with gold accents theme.
Hovering actions now highlight: When hovering over an action, it will light the button frame up while in the split view
🐛 Bug Fixes: Some UI Fixes: Various UI tweaks and fixes.

📋 Updates: Hotfix Detection: App now detects the HOTFIX channel.
🐛 Bug Fixes: XBOX controller support: fixed XBOX controller bindings not being displayed in visual mode.

📋 Updates: Collapsible keybindings sidebar: The Actions, Filters, and Categories sidebar can now be minimized and restored in both List and Split views. Your preference is remembered between sessions.
Improved compact layouts: The keybindings header, search field, binding tags, and action controls now reflow to make better use of narrow windows and split panes.
🐛 Bug Fixes: Action controls stay accessible: Manage, Clear, Reset, Bind, and Locate now move to their own row before they can overflow or become unclickable.
Binding tags wrap correctly: Long or multiple bindings no longer collapse into awkward narrow pills when horizontal space is limited.
Safer Split View sizing: Saved pane widths are constrained to the available window, and Split View stacks vertically on smaller windows so both panes remain usable.
